description: Repo hygiene (T1 item 10): README, LICENSE and the CI workflows exist, and the README and package.json say nothing the repo cannot back.

checks.name: no-placeholder-package-scripts
argv: import json,sys; s=json.load(open('package.json'))['scripts']; bad=[k for k,v in s.items() if 'exit 0' in v or 'No ' in v]; sys.exit('placeholder scripts: %s' % bad if bad else 0)
